iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 58. RISING: IAEA Director General Grossi demands "detailed verification measures" in any peace deal. IAEA gov2026-8 report: "cannot verify enrichment suspension" - 440kg 60% uranium location uncertain. JINSA report: Fordow expansion could yield several bombs per month. CSIS: current stockpiles sufficient for 10 weapons in 3 weeks. Iran envoy says not seeking 90% enrichment but rules out restrictions. E3 NPT statement March 2026. IAEA locked out of bombed facilities. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability 37%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 58. BLOCKADE DAY 2: US blockade fully operational - trade completely halted. Diplomats working back channels to arrange 2nd round talks. Pakistan racing to host. Trump hints talks within 48 hours. IRGC threatens to bomb US warships. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite blockade - direct challenge. Oil Brent ~$94.87, trending toward $100. IEA warns worst energy crisis in history. Ceasefire deadline Apr 22. Diplomatic window OPEN but military standoff deepens. Probability 62%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 58. WASHINGTON TALKS UNDERWAY: Sec Rubio hosting Israeli Ambassador Leiter and Lebanese Ambassador Hamadeh. Hezbollah Qassem rejects direct negotiations as "futile" and "treason." Israel rejects ceasefire, continues strikes - 35 killed in Lebanon past 24h. 350+ killed Apr 8 strikes. 1M+ displaced. Rubio: "not resolved in 6 hours." Hezbollah claims 24 attacks on Israel Tuesday. Pope demands ceasefire. Probability 45%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: SUSTAINED: Roketsan opens new missile production facilities - "largest defense investment in Republic history." Defense spending up 30% to $27.34B. Pushing for EU defense integration. 1,700 defense companies at SAHA 2026. ~100 defense agreements. Tayfun hypersonic serial production. Warns Israel as "Hitler of our time." S-400 saga unresolved. Probability 14%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR 2026 survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely - Tier II risk. Pakistani Defence Minister hostile warnings. 2025 Operation Sindoor precedent. Pakistan also mediating Iran ceasefire. Drivers of conflict intact - terrorism from Pakistan. No new escalations past 24h. Probability 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 62. SUSTAINED: Medvedev nuclear threats to Finland/Sweden as "automatic targets" - confirmed ongoing posture. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war vs neighbor in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Carnegie: belligerent post-war posture. Iran war "strategic windfall" - oil revenues surging billions. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. NPT Review shaping as battleground. Probability 68%. Stable.

china.name: China
china.notes: SUSTAINED: Taiwan tracking rising Chinese naval activity. Xi met KMT chairwoman Cheng Li-wun - "absolutely not tolerate" independence. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite US blockade - direct challenge. Wang Yi visited Pyongyang - China-NK rail resumed. PLA Type 055 destroyers live-fire drill. Chinese sanctions on Japanese lawmaker over Taiwan. $14B US arms for Taiwan. ISW/AEI updates weekly. Probability 33%. Stable.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 58. ESCALATING: Kim oversaw 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer Apr 12 - 2 cruise + 3 anti-ship missiles. Third round of destroyer tests in 6 weeks. Kim pledges boost to navy operational capability. 4th destroyer under construction. Cluster-bomb warheads tested last week. ODNI confirms full US mainland range ICBM. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Wang Yi visit strengthens China-NK axis. Probability 88%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1159+. SUSTAINED: ISW daily assessments continue. Russia Easter escalation - 110+ drones targeting civilians. Orthodox Easter truce collapsed. Patriot missile shortage as systems diverted to Iran theater. Russia regenerating tank force. Russia declares liberation of Luhansk. Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging billions. 1.2M Russian casualties estimated. Probability 82%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: SUSTAINED: China-mediated ceasefire talks continue in Urumqi - 2nd round underway. Mid-level Afghan Taliban delegation. Fighting continues worst since Taliban 2021. Temporary Eid ceasefire collapsed. Pakistan operations against TTP continue. Lowy Institute: "the other war the world is ignoring." Probability 22%. Stable.
